spec.description: Overall reported adoption across configured tenant sources and all environments, followed by one repeated detail section per selected tenant. Controller-reported Nais Postgres resources versus Config Connector Cloud SQL instances (all engines; engine labels unavailable). Unknown is not zero. Capacity covers discovered Nais Postgres DB pods, branches and replicas, not Cloud SQL or total service cost. Historical coverage depends on metric availability; no retrospective inventory is reconstructed.

panels.title: Overview — 8 configured tenant sources · all environments

panels.description: Across the explicit 8 configured tenant sources and every observed environment, independent of the detail selectors below. Reported counts only: compare inventory coverage with observed environments and configured tenants. Missing sources/inventory do not become zero; a partial sum is not complete inventory. Cloud SQL covers all engines/statuses. Teams are unique tenant + namespace across environments, not sums of dev/prod team counts. New/deleted datasource provisioning requires refreshing monitoring-sources.libsonnet. No migration percentage or event counts are inferred.

panels.title: Across tenants and environments — reported inventory

panels.description: Across the explicit 8 configured tenant sources and every observed environment, independent of the detail selectors below. Reported counts only: compare inventory coverage with observed environments and configured tenants. Missing sources/inventory do not become zero; a partial sum is not complete inventory. Cloud SQL covers all engines/statuses. Teams are unique tenant + namespace across environments, not sums of dev/prod team counts.
